topic: Assigning data and API documentation tasks
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on assigning work to a team member (Svyata) who needs tasks, particularly those involving data. A specific task was identified: updating the OpenAPI documentation within the `data-api` repository, ensuring that the JSDoc comments are kept synchronized with the implementation changes and deploying this via Swagger UI.

Additionally, there were discussions regarding technical infrastructure issues, including a temporary problem with user grants on a cluster requiring server restarts. This issue was ultimately resolved by someone.
decisions: Svyata will be assigned tasks related to data analysis and API documentation.
The OpenAPI specification needs to be kept current alongside implementation changes.
action_items: [me] is to create a ticket for the OpenAPI documentation task.
